Congratulations on completing this path! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Created a dedicated read-only Grafana user in your PostgreSQL database
- Added the PostgreSQL data source in Grafana Cloud
- Configured connection details including host, port, database name, and credentials
- Set the TLS/SSL mode for a secure connection
- Tested the database connection through PDC to your Grafana Cloud instance
- Verified PostgreSQL data access through Grafana's Explore feature

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following paths after you complete this path:

- [Create a private connection to a data source](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/private-data-source-connect/)
- [Monitor PostgreSQL with Grafana Alloy](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/postgresql-integration/)
- [Set up Database Observability for PostgreSQL](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/postgresql-db-olly/)
